capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: EV Database 2019-2020 Long Range AWD page: 78.8 kWh nominal, Panasonic 2170C NCA, 4,416 cells (96s46p). Same 4,416-cell Panasonic pack across 2017-2020 Long Range/Performance cars. 2018 car: EV Database page covers 2019-2020; evspecifications covers the 2018 AWD. The EPA-filing figure for the launch pack was 80.5 kWh and evspecifications lists 77.8 kWh; sources differ by about 2 kWh.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: EV Database 2019-2020 Long Range AWD page: 73.5 kWh usable (their estimate; CleanTechnica forum estimate 74.5; Musk's 2017 statement 75). Same 4,416-cell Panasonic pack across 2017-2020 Long Range/Performance cars. 2018 car: EV Database page covers 2019-2020; evspecifications covers the 2018 AWD.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Panasonic 2170C cells, NCA cathode (EV Database; evspecifications 2018 Long Range AWD also lists NCA). Same 4,416-cell Panasonic pack across 2017-2020 Long Range/Performance cars. 2018 car: EV Database page covers 2019-2020; evspecifications covers the 2018 AWD.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: 357 V nominal, "400 V architecture" per EV Database; evspecifications lists 350 V for the 2018 car. Same 4,416-cell Panasonic pack across 2017-2020 Long Range/Performance cars. 2018 car: EV Database page covers 2019-2020; evspecifications covers the 2018 AWD.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Tesla's release note (2020.24.6.4, Model S/3/X/Y) says the car preconditions its battery when navigating to a fast charger; this is a software feature delivered to the whole Model 3 line (Same 4,416-cell Panasonic pack across 2017-2020 Long Range/Performance cars. 2018 car: EV Database page covers 2019-2020; evspecifications covers the 2018 AWD.). Page mentions no manual battery-warming control. A manual control was neither found nor ruled out: Tesla's owner's manual pages were blocked (403) and scheduled-departure preconditioning in search excerpts is cabin-oriented.

dc_max_kw.notes: evspecifications (North American 2018 Long Range AWD): 250 kW DC; EV Database 2019-2020 and CleanTechnica (2019) agree for the Long Range pack on Supercharger V3 (V2 stalls give less). Same 4,416-cell Panasonic pack across 2017-2020 Long Range/Performance cars. 2018 car: EV Database page covers 2019-2020; evspecifications covers the 2018 AWD.

ac_max_kw.notes: Tesla Model 3 service manual: "accepts up to 48A when equipped with the Long Range Battery" ("about 11 kW"); 48 A x 240 V = 11.5 kW. evspecifications also lists 11.5 kW for the 2018 Long Range AWD. Same 4,416-cell Panasonic pack across 2017-2020 Long Range/Performance cars. 2018 car: EV Database page covers 2019-2020; evspecifications covers the 2018 AWD.
